svg.title: Sultana Express: A B2B sourcing marketplace for Turkish manufacturing, rebuilt from a no-code prototype as a platform.
svg.desc: Co-founder and cto · side project. 38 Go modules. 556 API operations. 45 decision records. Go · Next.js · Kubernetes · NATS JetStream. Case study: https://secretocho.design/work/sultana-express/
